# Review

Use `ai review <task_id> --tool claude` to generate the task-specific review prompt.

If the task painted anything, render its preview variant and LOOK at the image — reading a painter does not prove what it draws (`.ai/rules/visual-evidence.md`). Before accepting a fix, revert it in isolation and confirm its regression test actually fails.
